sources.entry: Iceshrimp.NET - Federated microblogging server that communicates over ActivityPub. (Source Code) EUPL-1.2 .NET/C#/Docker

summary.name: Iceshrimp.NET
summary.one_liner: Iceshrimp.NET is a federated microblogging server implementing ActivityPub, a new C#/.NET codebase continuing the Iceshrimp project.
use_cases: Run a self-hosted federated microblogging instance
Use Mastodon-compatible clients with a custom server
Participate in the fediverse with ActivityPub
Test or contribute to a new ActivityPub server codebase
summary.what_it_does: Iceshrimp is a decentralized, federated social networking service that implements the ActivityPub standard. It provides a web UI and a Mastodon-compatible client API, so users can connect Mastodon-compatible apps. The project is a new codebase continuing the Iceshrimp legacy, written mainly in C# (about 80%) with HTML and CSS frontend parts, and is distributed with a Dockerfile. The stated priorities are maintainability, stability, performance, and configurability, with bug fixes prioritized over features.
notable: Mastodon-compatible client API tested against several third-party clients
Written in C#/.NET with a focus on performance and stability
Project does not operate a flagship instance; documentation and feature comparison matrix provided for setting up instances
caveats: Explicitly labeled beta software; upgrading existing Iceshrimp-JS instances is not recommended yet
Stable release not yet available; features and bugs still being worked on
